overview:
**Fire danger is High today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by dry fuels (ERC 89%) despite calmer winds.**
- Danger holds High all week, easing mid-week (ERC dropping to 68% Tue-Wed) before rebuilding by Saturday as fuels dry again.
- Scattered showers and thunderstorms are expected today into Monday, with gusty west winds to 30 mph possible Monday afternoon.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted for the area, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect in Montrose, Delta, Ouray, San Miguel, and Gunnison-area BLM/county lands; the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests have removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- The Elk Fire near Lake City (Hinsdale County) is holding at 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with no new activity reported.
